headline.released_code_matches_prose_intent: yes -- the code keeps the first patch_num rows, which matches L222's prose ('the token portion is discarded'). So the code is not simply 'wrong'; the paper's formula is what cannot be resolved.
headline.consequence: under either candidate ordering the text is either discarded outright or, if placed first, would need a different truncation. The published implementation is provably text-free (measured gradient exactly 0).
